✨ AuraCleaner - Practical Storage Tidying Tool ✨

Is your storage always insufficient and filled with all kinds of messy useless files? Choose AuraCleaner to easily organize all redundant contents in your mobile phone and make your storage space tidy again.

🧹 Comprehensive File Cleaning Functions
✅ Junk File Cleaning
Scan out various useless residual junk files generated during daily use, safely remove them in batches, and remove hidden useless contents in one go.

✅ App Cache Cleaning
Clear accumulated application cache files generated by daily browsing and using software, effectively release occupied storage resources.

✅ Large File Cleaning
Quickly identify all oversized files stored locally, view detailed file information, and delete unused large files as needed.

✅ Screenshot Cleaning
Intelligently classify all screenshot pictures in the phone, one-click sort out invalid and expired screenshots, and clean up useless picture resources.

✅ Empty Folder Cleaning
Automatically detect all idle empty folders left after deleting files, clean them up with one click, and sort out messy directory structures.

✅ Duplicate File Cleaning
Accurately find repeated pictures, documents and other identical files in the phone, remove redundant copies, and avoid repeated space occupation.

Regular use of this tool to sort out redundant files can effectively save more available storage space, let your mobile store more favorite content, and bid farewell to the trouble of insufficient storage for a long time.

If you have any usage questions or functional suggestions, you can contact us via email: ulaloginapi@gmail.com
